runtimeTransform.summary: Preserved the supplied model, skeleton, hands, rifle, silencer, scope, magazine, materials and textures; kept the idle, walk, run, shoot and reload clips under stable ids and dropped the unused draw, one-shot and inspect clips; rebound the six magazine vertices the source left with no skin weight onto their mesh's dominant joint, which is what stretched the magazine across the frame during playback; replaced the glove metallic-roughness map with matte factors (metallic 0.02, roughness 0.78) because the packed map read as wet plastic under the arena environment light; downsampled embedded textures to 512px.
